app.name: Berhan Stock
app.subtitle: Multi-Branch Stock Management System
app.tagline: Every branch, every item, one clear picture.

landing.heroTitle: Every branch, every item, one clear picture.
landing.heroDesc: Track stock across your shops and warehouses. Every change is recorded as a movement, so your numbers always add up.
landing.previewTitle: What the system helps you manage

previewItems.stock: Stock quantities by branch, with consolidated views

previewItems.movements: Recorded stock movements and an audit trail

roles.admin: Configures company data and manages operations across branches.

roles.staff: Handles daily branch tasks such as sales, receiving and transfer handling.
roles.auditor: Reviews permitted records and reports with read-only access.
